description: Ask QA a question about an item. Put a question to QA on a queue item — use it when you do not know the answer yourself and QA's decision unblocks the work. The question is open until QA answers it; it surfaces on the item (`ops get` → `qaQuestions`) and in the project-wide QA backlog (`ops list --qa-question…

agent.description: The agent type asking — pass your own type when you are a coding agent. Omitted, the question is attributed to the caller's identity.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

question.description: What you need QA to answer (markdown). Include what you already tried.

name: ops_qa_questions_ask
